decision_conditions: The amendments to the approved application listed below is considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in its own right and will not require resubmission of a fresh planning application.
The following amendment is deemed to be accepted:

To allow for a change of the approved installation of a low-NOx boiler at the time under condition 18 to install an ASHP at nos. 61a and 61b to future-proof the development and improve sustainability credentials.

The applicant is reminded that the installation of the air source heat pump must comply with Building Regulations and relevant noise standards, including MCS 020 guidance. Any future changes to the location or specification of the unit may require further consent.
description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission ref: P0717.21 dated 05-11-21 to allow to include the installation and use of Air Source Heat Pump instead of boiler (Erection of 2 x two storey, 4-bed dwellings and 1x 4 bed bungalow with associated parking and amenity space following the demolition of existing detached bungalow)
